messages:
zoe: Quick FYI, QA flagged oddities in the per-model cost hovercards after we enabled low-rate sampling for some enterprise tenants. Some hovercards show implausible negative "cache savings" and wildly large CI ranges.
maria: yeah saw that, choked on a couple of tenant reports. example: model=redwood-7b, route=/summarize, sample_rate=0.005, hover shows -$0.12 +/- $0.45 which is not actionable.
rajiv: low sample noise + our warmup amortization is the usual suspect. When prefetched hits are rare the amortized warmup term dominates and flips the sign.
tessa: we should treat the hovercard as a statistical summary, not a single-number SLA claim. propose returning: {estimate, sample_count, std_err, ci95_low, ci95_high, method} from the API.
ben: agreed. backend can compute std_err = sqrt(p*(1-p)/n) * token_cost approximation for simple binomial-ish prefetched hit rate. but our real calc mixes token counts and amortized cost so we'll need a delta method or bootstrap.
sophie: bootstrap is simpler conceptually but heavy if done live. Can we precompute bootstrap rollups daily and use analytic approx for live?
rajiv: plan: if sample_count >= LIVE_N (config default 100) return live analytic estimate + ci. if sample_count between ROLLUP_MIN (30) and LIVE_N fallback to rollup daily aggregate (with a note). if sample_count < ROLLUP_MIN hide savings and show "insufficient samples" CTA.
zoe: UX: hover shows primary line as estimate, below small text "n=XX, 95% CI: [$L, $H]" and an icon linking to "why this might be noisy". clicking expands quick formula + how to force live.
maria: also need a per-tenant override for debuggers: ?force_live_estimate=true but guarded behind feature flag. audit when used.
ben: API changes: extend GET /telemetry/cost/hover?chain=... to return JSON keys: estimate, sample_count, ci_low, ci_high, source: ["live","rollup","suppressed"], method: ["analytic","bootstrap","rollup"], rollup_ts, advisory_message. Additionally set header X-Rollup-Used: true/false and X-Sample-Window: 7d.
rajiv: naming nit: prefer source instead of rollup_fallback boolean. makes response self-describing. method explains computation algorithm.
tessa: implementer notes for backend: compute analytic ci via delta-method derivative of savings wrt hit-rate. rough formula in docs: 
```
let h = observed_hit_rate;
let n = sample_count;
let toks_per_hit = mean_prefetched_tokens;
let unit = model_unit_cost;
estimate = h * toks_per_hit * unit - warmup_amortized;
var(h) = h*(1-h)/n;
std_err(estimate) = sqrt(var(h)) * toks_per_hit * unit;
ci95 = estimate +- 1.96*std_err
```
if toks_per_hit or unit have high variance, analytic breaks and fallback to bootstrap.
ben: will add a server-side flag to force bootstrap for routes we know have multimodal distributions. bootstrap job uses cached sample bucket stream and runs 1k resamples precomputed during rollup to keep latency low.
sophie: console changes: show CI band visual (thin translucent bar) over the sparkline in the hovercard; if source=="rollup" show a clock icon + "values from daily rollup (24h lag)"; if suppressed show "insufficient data" with CTAs: "increase sampling" (link to admin) | "force live" (dev only).
zoe: telemetry concerns: log events for every hover: hover_request with fields {chain, route, source, sample_count, user_flag_force_live}. Also log when user clicks "force live". we want to measure how often rollup is hiding regressions.
maria: concerning quota-limited tenants: they may appear low-sample but actually high traffic with many throttled responses. need to tag sample_count with effective_count = sample_count / (1 - throttle_rate) estimate or at least surface a banner: "quota throttling detected  samples may be biased".
rajiv: backend can compute throttle_rate from tenant metrics and include throttle_hint boolean. don't try to correct automatically; just surface advisory.
ben: implementation checklist:
- backend: add hover telemetry endpoint v2, produce fields above, X-Rollup-Used header, method selector
- rollup: precompute bootstrap CIs for high-variance routes and persist index
- console: hover UI/CI band, banners, force-live toggle (feature-flagged)
- docs: short explainer + analytic formula + guidance on thresholds
- ops: add org-config knobs: LIVE_N=100, ROLLUP_MIN=30, SAMPLE_WINDOW=7d
- telemetry: hover_request + force_live_click events
- security: ensure force_live is allowed only to dev/test roles

zoe: I'll prototype the hover payload shape in a mock PR and add unit tests for the analytic ci calc.
ben: branch: feat/hover-stats-v2. I'll include header X-Rollup-Used and code to pick bootstrap vs analytic.
maria: can you post a link to the mock payload example here when ready? I'd like to test with the tenant that triggered the support ticket.
deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary deploy for telemetry-hover-v2 at +12m :rocket:
zoe: thanks all. once canary is up I'll validate against the negative cache savings cases and confirm UX behaves (rollup fallback, banner, force-live audit).
